key_insight: PyroDash makes inference cheaper by letting a small model handle easy tokens and selectively call a large model only when needed. This token-level collaboration aims to keep most of the efficiency of small models while recovering large-model quality on hard reasoning steps.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the high serving cost of large language models and the reliability gap of small language models on difficult generation and reasoning tasks.
method: The small language model generates tokens and emits a special control token when it needs help.
A Collaborate Engine forwards the current query plus partial reasoning trace to a frozen large language model for completion.
The system uses token-level, cost-aware routing so assistance is requested only at critical moments rather than for every prompt.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this offers a practical path to reduce inference cost without fully sacrificing answer quality. It is especially relevant for deployment settings where latency, budget, and throughput matter.
